newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC sees growth across group in 1997.
newsitem.headline: HSBC sees growth across group in 1997.

text.p: HSBC Holdings Plc chairman William Purves said on Monday that all parts of the group are likely to grow in 1997.

"We are likely to see growth right across the group," Purves told a news conference in Hong Kong when asked about the earnings outlook for 1997. "I would like to see organic growth from within the group."
HSBC earlier announced 1996 pretax profit at 4.52 billion sterling against 3.67 billion sterling the previous year.
"But the bigger you get the more difficult it is to achieve results like these," Purves cautioned.
Purves said he did not think the banking giant had any need for new capital. "We are a well capitalised bank," he said.
But he added he hoped credit rating agencies would review their ratings for the bank.
"I hope the rating agencies will take another look at us given our good results," he said.
